title: PH eyes medal haul in Asian Para Games with 69-strong delegation
summary: The Philippines will bank on a 69-athlete delegation competing in 11 sports to deliver a strong campaign in the upcoming Asian Para Games from Oct. 18 to 24 in Nagoya, Japan.
